## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:同步导入 `POST /data/OBJ/import` 现在先问对象在不在:没注册的对象回 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`,停用包里的对象回 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`,和数据门 `POST /data/OBJ` 一字不差(原来回 200,错误藏在每行结果里)。两个导入门与 API 暴露闸都改用同一种读法:旧式 `ns__short` 对象用短名访问时,认的就是数据门认的那个对象。
- 为什么改:按分诊 6509235875(#27728)与 6509225810(#27729):只看状态码的导入客户端,拼错对象名时会以为成功;作业门对短名比数据门更严;暴露闸对短名放行,`apiEnabled: false` 的 `ns__short` 对象用短名能被读写(实测)。
- 风险与回滚:收窄,已写 BREAKING 说明;只影响拼错/未注册/停用包的对象名和带 `__` 的旧对象名,已发运的对象都不带 `__`。回滚即删 `data-action-routes.ts` 里同步门那一行调用,再把两处 `item.name === name` 比较加回去。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`(同步门新增的 `assertImportObjectExists` 调用与函数里去掉的名字比较);`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `loadObjectItem`;新测试 `packages/rest/src/import-door-object-existence.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/import-door-object-existence.test.ts`,预期 11/11 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(合同复审由席位安排)。

## What changes

- **#27728, the synchronous import door.** `POST /data/:object/import` now calls `assertImportObjectExists` right after the API-exposure gate and before the control opt-out gate and the body parse, the same place the async job door asks it (#27711). An unregistered object answers the data door's 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, byte for byte; an object of a disabled package answers its 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. Nothing is parsed or written, dry run included. Placed after the exposure gate, so a hidden object keeps its 404 and the door is no existence oracle.
- **#27729 item 1, pinned.** The async job door's disabled-package refusal (propagated since #27711, read from the code) is now measured: status and body `toEqual` the data door's answer for the same name, zero `sys_import_job` rows, zero object rows. It was already green on the base, as #27711 said.
- **#27729 item 2, one read.** `assertImportObjectExists` and the exposure gate's `loadObjectItem` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`) both dropped `item.name === name`: whatever item the by-name read serves counts. That read (`getMetaItemForExecution`, else `getMetaItem`) resolves a legacy `ns__short` object from its short name exactly as the data door's `registry.getObject` does (measured: `widget` → `exl__widget` on both). Results:
  - the job door creates a job for a short name the data door serves, where it answered `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`;
  - the exposure gate judges the resolved object's `enable`. Before, a short name was "no object here" to the gate and passed through, so an `ns__short` object with `enable.apiEnabled: false` was served under its short name (measured on the base: `POST /data/vault` 201, sync import 200, while `POST /data/exl__vault` answered 404 `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`). Now all three doors answer 404 `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` for the short name too.
  - The list fallback (a protocol with no by-name read) keeps its name match; it has no resolution to follow, and the docblock says so.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/rest` patch, BREAKING note, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/import-door-object-existence.test.ts` (new), real `RestServer` routes on a real `ObjectQL` engine + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, SQLite `:memory:`, real `sys_import_job`, real `disablePackage`:

- #27728: unregistered object → sync door 404 equal to the data door's body; dry run and an unparseable CSV body get the same answer; control: a registered object still imports (200, 1 row).
- #27729 item 1: disabled package → data door 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; sync and job doors equal it (status + body), zero job rows, zero object rows.
- #27729 item 2: premise (`registry.getObject('widget')` → `exl__widget`, data door 201); job door 201 + one job row for the short name; sync door imports under it; an unregistered short name is still `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` at both import doors, zero job rows; `apiEnabled: false` object hidden under its short name at the data, sync and job doors, zero rows.

Ablation (both source files reverted to `main`, test kept): 6 of 11 red (the two #27728 cases, the sync disabled-package case, and three short-name cases); the 5 that stay green are the controls, the data-door reference reading, and the job-door disabled-package pin (already true on the base). Restored: 11/11.

## Acceptance notes

- Triage rulings followed as written; nothing re-ruled.
- Out of scope, read from the code and not measured: the cross-object `POST /batch` per-op exposure gate (`batch-routes.ts`) keys the object LIST by `name`, so it keeps the old short-name pass-through. This harness's runtime answers 501 for a transactional batch, so it could not be measured here. Noted for the seat; not filed.
